rationale: Ground truth has no substantive reviewer concerns, so both trivially achieve full recall. Both candidates correctly validate the core fix and tests without fabricating blockers, converging on the same sm_110a observation independently (suggesting it's grounded in real PR context). X goes further with three concrete, file/line-anchored suggestions (missing (10,1) test case, docstring gap, stale pyproject.toml comment) that are specific and actionable even if minor, while Y's single comment is heavily hedged ('almost certainly fine', 'low-signal enough to omit') and reads more as a passing thought than an actionable ask.
